answeredQuestions.target-users: TeamBot users initializing projects with existing .agent/ directories
answeredQuestions.core-problem: Users cannot easily understand or resolve conflicts between existing .agent/ files and updated scaffold versions
answeredQuestions.success-metrics: Conflicts detected and resolved on first attempt, no workflow failures from stale prompts
answeredQuestions.testing-approach: TDD - write tests for conflict detection logic first
answeredQuestions.scope-boundaries: Focus on .agent/ directory conflicts only, not other scaffold files

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: CopyResult with reasons: copied, skipped_exists, source_missing, skipped_not_empty. copy_scaffold_directory checks if non-empty.
cmd_init() calls copy_all_scaffolds() with force flag, displays warnings for skipped_not_empty
sync_sdd_prompts handles sdd.*.prompt.md pattern, similar skip logic
